blocks.text: You can create and customize lure passwords and place them in browser lures, session lures, and file decoys. When these lure passwords are enumerated by attackers, the event is logged as an attack.
To create lure passwords via a landmine policy:

blocks.item: Locate the policy, and click the Edit icon.
In the policy configuration window, click Password Settings and configure the options:

If you do not configure password settings or enable the feature, the system automatically generates realistic lure passwords using default complexity rules. Lure passwords continue to be deployed for all enabled lure types and are omitted only when the corresponding lure policy is disabled.
Enabled: Select to deploy password settings when the policy is distributed.
Enable or disable the following password characteristics as required:
Must have at least one uppercase letter
Min Length: Enter the minimum number of characters for the passwords.
Max Length: Enter the maximum number of characters for the passwords.
Password Keywords: Enter a list of keywords that must be used as a part of the base password.

Make sure that the password settings are similar to your organization's password policy. Use keywords matching your organization name, project name, or internal code name. Alternatively, you can use generic terms that are used in a weak password to lure attackers.
